annotations.title: List what the CRA technical documentation must contain

description: Lists what the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical documentation must contain (Annex VII) and which conformity assessment routes a product class allows (Art. 32): internal control (self-assessment, module A), EU-type examination by a notified body (module B + C), full quality assurance (module H) or a certification scheme. Optional inputs: the product class (default, important class I or II, critical) and whether the product includes hardware. Returns the eight Annex VII items with their article points, the keeping, language and CE-marking duties, and the routes. Does not review documents and is not a conformity assessment; for the product class itself: cra_scope_check.

hardware.description: true if the product includes hardware (adds the photographs and illustrations item).

product_class.description: CRA product class, if known (default, important class I or II, critical; for example from cra_scope_check). Without it, the conformity assessment routes for every class are listed.
